additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active build-scope resources. Later Measure-family decisions refined the same area: FHIR-29807 clarified supplementalData reporting against MeasureReport, FHIR-20723 added valueSet/unit support to supplementalData and stratifier definitions, and FHIR-50488 added supplementalData inputs to Measure $evaluate. Current Measure.supplementalData explains criteria and resource/Observation reporting, Measure.supplementalData.usage includes risk-adjustment-factor, Measure.riskAdjustment describes risk adjustment, MeasureReport.supplementalData explains report representation, and the Quality Reporting topic describes individual and summary supplementalData use with CMS146 examples.
